title: finding(core): the `$select` harvest `listViewPredicates` reads `visible` / `disabled` / `recordIdField` but not a row action's `defaultFromRow` params or `{field}` URL tokens, so on a projected row those prefills come up empty without a word
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a named site (the class-(c) metadata trap: an action param the runtime silently drops). Reader: the `domain:ui` execution seat that claims it after triage grades it. The fix site is the core predicate harvest (`listViewPredicates` / `collectPredicateFieldRefs`), which `ListView`, `ObjectGrid` and, since objectui#10186, `RelatedList`'s authored path all use to decide which fields their `$select` must carry.

Filed by the `domain:ui#4` execution seat (`session_01BP8CMtACxTdLjqR6rhd33C`) at ACCEPT of objectui#10186. The dev found it by reading source (report on objectui#10186). ⛔ **NOT MEASURED end to end**: triage should weigh that. ⛔ It is filed bare.

## The trap

A list that projects its rows (`$select`) keeps only the fields its columns, `id`, `$expand` roots and row predicates need. The harvest that finds those predicate fields reads `visible`, `disabled` and `recordIdField`, but not:
- an action's `params[].defaultFromRow` field keys;
- the `{field}` tokens in its `target` URL.

On a projected row such a field is simply absent. So:
- `resolveActionParams` finds nothing (it checks `hasOwnProperty` on the row) and silently skips the prefill;
- the `{field}` URL interpolation writes an empty string.

Metadata an author writes, such as `defaultFromRow: true` on a param bound to a field that is not a column, is dropped at runtime without any message.

A named producer of this metadata shape: objectstack `platform-objects` `sys-team-member.object.ts` → action `remove_team_member` (params `teamId` / `userId`, `defaultFromRow: true`, fields `team_id` / `user_id`).

The dev checked the shipped platform related lists: each `defaultFromRow` there names `id` or a column, so none is known to be hit today on `RelatedList`. `ListView` / `ObjectGrid` were not surveyed.

## Dedupe

Query: `listViewPredicates defaultFromRow projection $select row action prefill field not projected` (objectui, open + closed) ⇒ 2 hits:
- objectui#10186 (open). This is the must-hit control, and it did hit.
- objectui#7216 (closed completed), which covers speculative binding fields and FLS, ⛔ not the action-param harvest.

⇒ No duplicate.

Dedupe words: `listViewPredicates defaultFromRow harvest` · `$select projection drops defaultFromRow prefill` · `row action URL token field not projected` · `predicate-fields recordIdField defaultFromRow`
